description.en: Statically generated, bilingual and accessible site with light/dark themes.
description.id: Situs statis dua bahasa yang aksesibel dengan tema terang/gelap.

description.en: Café menu with search, filters, a saved cart, promo codes and an accessible demo checkout.
description.id: Menu kafe dengan pencarian, filter, keranjang tersimpan, kode promo dan checkout demo yang aksesibel.

description.en: Order back office with mock sign-in, live RxJS order feed, typed reactive forms and accessible SVG charts.
description.id: Back office pesanan dengan login tiruan, feed pesanan RxJS real-time, reactive forms bertipe dan grafik SVG yang aksesibel.

description.en: Invoice editor with a tested pricing engine: line discounts, service fee, tax (exclusive or inclusive) and rounding.
description.id: Editor invoice dengan mesin harga yang teruji: diskon item, biaya layanan, pajak (belum/sudah termasuk) dan pembulatan.
